findingDetails.title: The contracted "make changes" instruction is not in the no-edit vocabulary, so a mutating command is offered on a plain no-edit prompt
findingDetails.scopeProof: isNoEditRequest is the single predicate, called at command-attach.ts:338, fusion.ts:677, fusion.ts:881 and text.ts:150; no caller adds a second check.
findingDetails.case: Prompt "use sk-doc to create an agent called invoice-parser, don't make any changes yet" returns false from isNoEditRequest and "/create:agent" (policy start, mutating) from attachCommand, while "don't change anything yet" and "make no changes to existing agents" both return true and no command.
findingDetails.claim: NO_EDIT_REQUEST covers the contraction with an immediate change verb and the literal make-no-changes phrase but not the contracted make-changes instruction, so the shared guard misses a plausible no-edit prompt and attachCommand offers a mutating command.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked every pattern alternative against the failing prompts; read all four call sites; ran the pinned sibling prompts to show the guard fires for them.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The contracted form may be excluded because it can also be a scope-limited change request. Rejected: the settled decision resolves that ambiguity for the identical phrase in favour of the safe reading, so the contraction should get the same treatment.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade to P2 if the maintainer declares the no-edit vocabulary closed at the pinned phrasings.

spec_code.notes: 846eab66b8 claim verified for the literal make-no-changes phrase; the contracted form is a gap (HC3-P1-001).

checklist_evidence.notes: No checklist.md in the target packet.
